suggestions: I'm grateful for a deploy on a Friday afternoon that actually went clean, no rollback drama.
I'm thankful for the quiet ten minutes before Fajr when the whole flat is still asleep but me.
I'm grateful for finding the root cause in the logs instead of just adding another try-catch and hoping.
I'm thankful for my dad still calling just to ask if I've eaten, every single time.
I'm grateful for a cup of teh tarik that actually has the right amount of pulling, not watered down.
I'm thankful for a code review comment that taught me something instead of just nitpicking semicolons.
I'm grateful for rain hitting the roof right as I'm about to sleep after a long day of meetings.
I'm thankful for a manager who said 'take the day off' and actually meant it.
I'm grateful for the rezeki of a paycheck landing on time when half my friends are freelancing month to month.
I'm thankful for a sibling group chat that's 90% nonsense but still makes me laugh at 1am.
I'm grateful for a flaky test that finally stopped being flaky after I actually read the error properly.
I'm thankful for the imam keeping the khutbah short on a day I was running on three hours of sleep.
I'm grateful for a stranger at the mamak who quietly paid for my teh o ais and just walked off.
I'm thankful for a weekend with no on-call pager going off, not even once.
I'm grateful for old kawan-kawan from uni who still remember my birthday without a reminder app.
